unit.title: A no that still leaves room for friendship
canDo: Decline an invitation with a truthful specific reason
Distinguish declining an event from rejecting a friendship
Offer and keep a concrete alternative plan

example.en: Asking the person first is our principle for this.

grammar.purpose: Clarify what is and is not being declined
grammar.explanation: 不是不 rejects a negative interpretation, often followed by a specific reason after 而是. Avoid relying on double negatives alone when the other person needs a clear answer.

examples.zh: 我不是不想见你，而是今天想早点回家。
examples.py: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng jiàn nǐ , ér shì jīn tiān xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā .
examples.en: It isn’t that I don’t want to see you; I want to go home early today.

examples.zh: 我不是不喜欢，只是现在吃不下。
examples.py: wǒ bù shì bù xǐ huān , zhǐ shì xiàn zài chī bù xià .
examples.en: It isn’t that I dislike it; I can’t eat any more now.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我不是不想见你，所以我不想见你。
commonMistakes.right: 我不是不想见你，而是今天想早点回家。
commonMistakes.why: The second clause should clarify the actual limitation.

grammar.purpose: Explain a motivation that led to an action
grammar.explanation: 怕 can introduce an anticipated unwelcome outcome; 才 highlights how it motivated the action. This explains the speaker’s decision, not the other person’s actual feelings.

examples.zh: 我怕你不高兴，才一直没说。
examples.py: wǒ pà nǐ bù gāo xìng , cái yì zhí méi shuō .
examples.en: I kept quiet because I was worried you’d be upset.

examples.zh: 怕赶不上车，我才提前出门。
examples.py: pà gǎn bù shàng chē , wǒ cái tí qián chū mén .
examples.en: I left early because I was worried I’d miss the train.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我怕你不高兴，所以你一定不高兴。
commonMistakes.right: 我怕你不高兴，才一直没说。
commonMistakes.why: A feared reaction is not a verified reaction.

grammar.purpose: Keep a choice or result despite a difficult condition
grammar.explanation: 哪怕 introduces an extreme condition, and 也 gives the result that still holds. It may be hypothetical; it does not force another person to accept your choice.

examples.zh: 哪怕只坐十分钟，我也想见你一下。
examples.py: nǎ pà zhǐ zuò shí fēn zhōng , wǒ yě xiǎng jiàn nǐ yī xià .
examples.en: Even if I can stay only ten minutes, I still want to see you.

examples.zh: 哪怕别人会失望，我也不能每次都答应。
examples.py: nǎ pà bié ren huì shī wàng , wǒ yě bù néng měi cì dōu dā yìng .
examples.en: Even if someone will be disappointed, I can’t agree every time.

commonMistakes.wrong: 哪怕只坐十分钟，所以我坐了一整天。
commonMistakes.right: 哪怕只坐十分钟，我也想见你一下。
commonMistakes.why: The result should remain compatible with the stated condition.

grammar.pattern: 比 + vague action + 更 / 有用
grammar.explanation: Use 比 to compare two actions, and state the dimension of comparison after the second action or in the predicate. This is a situated comparison, not a universal ranking of people.

examples.zh: 约好具体时间，比只说以后再约更有用。
examples.py: yuē hǎo jù tǐ shí jiān , bǐ zhǐ shuō yǐ hòu zài yuē gèng yǒu yòng .
examples.en: Agreeing a specific time is more useful than just saying we’ll meet sometime.

examples.zh: 早点回复，比当天才说更方便安排。
examples.py: zǎo diǎn huí fù , bǐ dàng tiān cái shuō gèng fāng biàn ān pái .
examples.en: Replying early makes planning easier than saying it on the day.

commonMistakes.wrong: 比早点回复，我当天说更早点。
commonMistakes.right: 早点回复，比当天才说更方便安排。
commonMistakes.why: Compare the same practical dimension with a coherent word order.

dialogue.title: 这次不去，周二见
dialogue.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 周六生日聚会你来吧？我还没算人数。
lines.py: zhōu liù shēng rì jù huì nǐ lái ba ? wǒ hái méi suàn rén shù .
lines.en: You’ll come to the birthday gathering on Saturday, right? I haven’t counted everyone yet.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谢谢你叫我，不过这次我就不去了。
lines.py: xiè xiè nǐ jiào wǒ , bù guò zhè cì wǒ jiù bù qù le .
lines.en: Thanks for inviting me, but I think I’ll sit this one out.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那天有事？
lines.py: nà tiān yǒu shì ?
lines.en: Do you have something on that day?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 也不是。最近每天都和人说话，我想在家安静一晚。
lines.py: yě bù shì . zuì jìn měi tiān dōu hé rén shuō huà , wǒ xiǎng zài jiā ān jìng yī wǎn .
lines.en: Not really. I’ve been talking to people every day recently and want a quiet evening at home.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你是不是不想见我？
lines.py: nǐ shì bú shì bù xiǎng jiàn wǒ ?
lines.en: Is it that you don’t want to see me?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是不想见你。大聚会我现在有点累，单独吃饭我很愿意。
lines.py: bù shì bù xiǎng jiàn nǐ . dà jù huì wǒ xiàn zài yǒu diǎn lèi , dān dú chī fàn wǒ hěn yuàn yì .
lines.en: It isn’t that I don’t want to see you. A big gathering feels tiring right now; I’d be very happy to have dinner just with you.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那下周二呢？七点在以前那家店？
lines.py: nà xià zhōu èr ne ? qī diǎn zài yǐ qián nà jiā diàn ?
lines.en: How about next Tuesday? Seven at that place we used to go to?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，我答应你。不过你生日那天，我还是会给你电话。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ dā yìng nǐ . bù guò nǐ shēng rì nà tiān , wǒ hái shi huì gěi nǐ diàn huà .
lines.en: Yes, I promise. I’ll still call you on your birthday too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。我刚才还真有点误会了。你以后直接说就好。
lines.py: xíng . wǒ gāng cái hái zhēn yǒu diǎn wù huì le . nǐ yǐ hòu zhí jiē shuō jiù hǎo .
lines.en: Okay. I really did misunderstand a little just now. Tell me directly next time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我也是怕你不高兴，才拖到今天说。下次早点回复。
lines.py: wǒ yě shì pà nǐ bù gāo xìng , cái tuō dào jīn tiān shuō . xià cì zǎo diǎn huí fù .
lines.en: I was worried you’d be upset, which is why I put it off until today. I’ll reply earlier next time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 早点说我就不用一直问。礼物可别忘了。
lines.py: zǎo diǎn shuō wǒ jiù bù yòng yì zhí wèn . lǐ wù kě bié wàng le .
lines.en: If you say it sooner, I don’t have to keep asking. Don’t forget the present, though.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你不是说不在乎礼物吗？
lines.py: nǐ bù shì shuō bù zài hū lǐ wù ma ?
lines.en: Didn’t you say you didn’t care about presents?
lines.speaker: b

Ask the host to cancel the birthday

Saturday at noon
Sunday at five

reading.title: 这次不去，周二见
reading.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
reading.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 周六聚会以后，陈宇给我发了一张照片。照片里有十几个人，大家围着桌子唱生日歌。我替他高兴，也知道自己那晚确实没有精力参加。
lines.py: zhōu liù jù huì yǐ hòu , chén yǔ gěi wǒ fā le yī zhāng zhào piān . zhào piān lǐ yǒu shí jǐ gè rén , dà jiā wéi zhe zhuō zi chàng shēng rì gē . wǒ tì tā gāo xìng , yě zhī dào zì jǐ nà wǎn què shí méi yǒu jīng lì cān jiā .
lines.en: After Saturday’s gathering, Chen Yu sent me a photo. More than ten people were singing around the table. I was happy for him and knew I really hadn’t had the energy to join that night.

lines.zh: 以前我遇到这种邀请，常常先答应，到当天才说去不了。朋友没时间重新安排，我也觉得不好意思。这次我在人数确定之前就回复了。
lines.py: yǐ qián wǒ yù dào zhè zhǒng yāo qǐng , cháng cháng xiān dā yìng , dào dàng tiān cái shuō qù bù le . péng you méi shí jiān chóng xīn ān pái , wǒ yě jué de bù hǎo yì sī . zhè cì wǒ zài rén shù què dìng zhī qián jiù huí fù le .
lines.en: I used to accept this sort of invitation and then cancel on the day. That left friends no time to adjust and made me feel bad. This time I replied before the headcount was fixed.

lines.zh: 一开始他以为我不想见他，我就把两件事分开解释：我不想参加大聚会，但想和他单独吃饭。我们约了下周二七点，他不用为了我改变周六的活动。
lines.py: yī kāi shǐ tā yǐ wéi wǒ bù xiǎng jiàn tā , wǒ jiù bǎ liǎng jiàn shì fēn kāi jiě shì : wǒ bù xiǎng cān jiā dà jù huì , dàn xiǎng hé tā dān dú chī fàn . wǒ men yuē le xià zhōu èr qī diǎn , tā bù yòng wèi le wǒ gǎi biàn zhōu liù de huó dòng .
lines.en: At first he thought I didn’t want to see him. I explained the two things separately: I didn’t want the big gathering but did want dinner with him. We arranged Tuesday at seven, without changing Saturday’s event for me.

lines.zh: 生日当天，我给他打了电话。没说很多话，只问聚会准备得怎么样，祝他生日快乐。他说饭已经够了，让我下次别又带一大盒点心。
lines.py: shēng rì dàng tiān , wǒ gěi tā dǎ le diàn huà . méi shuō hěn duō huà , zhǐ wèn jù huì zhǔn bèi de zěn me yàng , zhù tā shēng rì kuài lè . tā shuō fàn yǐ jīng gòu le , ràng wǒ xià cì bié yòu dài yī dà hé diǎn xīn .
lines.en: On his birthday I called, asked how preparations were going and wished him a happy birthday. He said there was enough food and told me not to bring another huge box of pastries next time.

lines.zh: 周二见面时，我带了一小盒。他看了看，说“这回你真的听进去了”。我们吃完饭，又聊了周六的照片，没有再争论我为什么没去。
lines.py: zhōu èr jiàn miàn shí , wǒ dài le yī xiǎo hé . tā kàn le kàn , shuō zhè huí nǐ zhēn de tīng jìn qù le . wǒ men chī wán fàn , yòu liáo le zhōu liù de zhào piān , méi yǒu zài zhēng lùn wǒ wèi shén me méi qù .
lines.en: When we met Tuesday, I brought a small box. He looked and said, “You really listened this time.” After dinner we talked about the photos without returning to the argument about my absence.

lines.zh: 我发现说清楚一个具体安排，比反复说“以后再约”有用。当然，有时别人还是会失望。解释并不能让所有人立刻高兴，但至少让这次决定少一点误会。
lines.py: wǒ fā xiàn shuō qīng chǔ yī gè jù tǐ ān pái , bǐ fǎn fù shuō yǐ hòu zài yuē yǒu yòng . dāng rán , yǒu shí bié ren hái shi huì shī wàng . jiě shì bìng bù néng ràng suǒ yǒu rén lì kè gāo xìng , dàn zhì shǎo ràng zhè cì jué dìng shǎo yī diǎn wù huì .
lines.en: I found that a concrete plan was more useful than repeatedly saying, “Let’s meet sometime.” People can still feel disappointed. An explanation doesn’t instantly please everyone, but it can reduce misunderstanding about this decision.

choices: A specific explanation and a kept alternative plan
Repeated vague promises with no date
Changing the whole birthday event
questions.answer: A specific explanation and a kept alternative plan

questions.q: What does the narrator bring on Tuesday?
choices: A small box of pastries
A large refrigerator
No gift after promising a large box

questions.q: What does the narrator learn about explanations?
choices: They may help without instantly removing all disappointment
They guarantee every person is happy
They make earlier replies unnecessary
questions.answer: They may help without instantly removing all disappointment

extraReadings.title: A small box, apparently
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 这是一小盒？
lines.py: zhè shì yī xiǎo hé ?
lines.en: This is a small box?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，上次那个盒子有这么大。
lines.py: duì , shàng cì nà gè hé zi yǒu zhè me dà .
lines.en: Yes. Last time the box was this big.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你拿手比也没用，我记得上次的。
lines.py: nǐ ná shǒu bǐ yě méi yòng , wǒ jì de shàng cì de .
lines.en: The hand gestures won’t help. I remember the last one.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 今天这个真的小了。你不在乎礼物，还在乎盒子大小？
lines.py: jīn tiān zhè gè zhēn de xiǎo le . nǐ bù zài hū lǐ wù , hái zài hū hé zi dà xiǎo ?
lines.en: Today’s really smaller. You don’t care about the present, but you care about the box size?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我在乎冰箱能不能放下。
lines.py: wǒ zài hū bīng xiāng néng bù néng fàng xià .
lines.en: I care whether it fits in the fridge.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我们现在吃掉一半，就放得下了。
lines.py: nà wǒ men xiàn zài chī diào yí bàn , jiù fàng de xià le .
lines.en: Then we’ll eat half now, and it’ll fit.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这个方案我赞成。
lines.py: zhè gè fāng àn wǒ zàn chéng .
lines.en: I approve of that plan.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 看吧，还是一起吃饭最容易说明白。
lines.py: kàn ba , hái shi yì qǐ chī fàn zuì róng yì shuō míng bái .
lines.en: See? Things are easiest to clear up over dinner.
lines.speaker: b

extraReadings.title: A no that still leaves room for friendship: words in context
extraReadings.titleZh: 这次不去，周二见 · 词语练习
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Retrieve these words in separate everyday situations.

lines.zh: 先问本人，是我们做这件事的原则。
lines.py: xiān wèn běn rén , shì wǒ men zuò zhè jiàn shì de yuán zé .
lines.en: Asking the person first is our principle for this.

lines.zh: 他的原则是不借别人的账号。
lines.py: tā de yuán zé shì bù jiè bié ren de zhàng hào .
lines.en: His principle is not to borrow someone else’s account.

lines.zh: 我不在乎坐哪里，只要能听清。
lines.py: wǒ bù zài hū zuò nǎ lǐ , zhǐ yào néng tīng qīng .
lines.en: I don’t mind where I sit as long as I can hear.

lines.zh: 她不在乎礼物贵不贵，更喜欢自己做的。
lines.py: tā bù zài hū lǐ wù guì bù guì , gèng xǐ huān zì jǐ zuò de .
lines.en: She doesn’t care whether a gift is expensive; she prefers homemade ones.

lines.zh: 我在乎的是你愿不愿意来，不是礼物。
lines.py: wǒ zài hū de shì nǐ yuàn bù yuàn yì lái , bù shì lǐ wù .
lines.en: What matters to me is whether you want to come, not the gift.

lines.zh: 他很在乎朋友的意见。
lines.py: tā hěn zài hū péng you de yì jiàn .
lines.en: He cares a lot about his friends' opinions.

lines.zh: 和她相处很轻松，不用一直找话题。
lines.py: hé tā xiāng chǔ hěn qīng sōng , bù yòng yì zhí zhǎo huà tí .
lines.en: Spending time with her is easy; I don’t have to keep finding topics.

lines.zh: 我们相处了一年，才发现喜欢同一种音乐。
lines.py: wǒ men xiāng chǔ le yī nián , cái fā xiàn xǐ huān tóng yī zhǒng yīn yuè .
lines.en: We spent a year together before realising we liked the same music.

lines.zh: 我可能误会了，你不是这个意思吧？
lines.py: wǒ kě néng wù huì le , nǐ bù shì zhè gè yì si ba ?
lines.en: I may have misunderstood; that isn’t what you meant, is it?

lines.zh: 这个误会解释清楚以后，我们都笑了。
lines.py: zhè gè wù huì jiě shì qīng chǔ yǐ hòu , wǒ men dōu xiào le .
lines.en: We both laughed once the misunderstanding was cleared up.

lines.zh: 刚到新的地方，难免有点不习惯。
lines.py: gāng dào xīn de dì fāng , nán miǎn yǒu diǎn bù xí guàn .
lines.en: It’s natural to feel a little unfamiliar in a new place.

lines.zh: 两个人一起做事，难免会有不同意见。
lines.py: liǎng gè rén yì qǐ zuò shì , nán miǎn huì yǒu bù tóng yì jiàn .
lines.en: When two people work together, disagreements are hard to avoid.

lines.zh: 他们第一次约会是在这家咖啡店。
lines.py: tā men dì yī cì yuē huì shì zài zhè jiā kā fēi diàn .
lines.en: Their first date was at this café.

lines.zh: 我今晚有约会，不能参加聚会。
lines.py: wǒ jīn wǎn yǒu yuē huì , bù néng cān jiā jù huì .
lines.en: I have a date tonight, so I can’t join the gathering.

lines.zh: 我承认自己回复得太晚了。
lines.py: wǒ chéng rèn zì jǐ huí fù de tài wǎn le .
lines.en: I admit I replied too late.

lines.zh: 他终于承认把地址看错了。
lines.py: tā zhōng yú chéng rèn bǎ dì zhǐ kàn cuò le .
lines.en: He finally admitted he’d misread the address.

lines.zh: 我担心你以为我不想见你。
lines.py: wǒ dān xīn nǐ yǐ wéi wǒ bù xiǎng jiàn nǐ .
lines.en: I’m worried you’ll think I don’t want to see you.

lines.zh: 别担心，我到家以后会给你消息。
lines.py: bié dān xīn , wǒ dào jiā yǐ hòu huì gěi nǐ xiāo xī .
lines.en: Don’t worry; I’ll message you when I get home.

lines.zh: 我想考虑一下，明天回复你。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng kǎo lǜ yī xià , míng tiān huí fù nǐ .
lines.en: I’d like to think about it and reply tomorrow.

lines.zh: 你不用只考虑我的时间。
lines.py: nǐ bù yòng zhǐ kǎo lǜ wǒ de shí jiān .
lines.en: You don’t need to consider only my schedule.

lines.zh: 谢谢你这么快回复。
lines.py: xiè xiè nǐ zhè me kuài huí fù .
lines.en: Thanks for replying so quickly.

lines.zh: 我还没有收到他的回复。
lines.py: wǒ hái méi yǒu shōu dào tā de huí fù .
lines.en: I haven’t received his reply yet.

lines.zh: 你可以直接告诉我，不用猜我想听什么。
lines.py: nǐ kě yǐ zhí jiē gào sù wǒ , bù yòng cāi wǒ xiǎng tīng shén me .
lines.en: You can tell me directly; no need to guess what I want to hear.

lines.zh: 这班车可以直接到学校。
lines.py: zhè bān chē kě yǐ zhí jiē dào xué xiào .
lines.en: This service goes straight to the school.

lines.zh: 她的态度很认真，但说话不重。
lines.py: tā de tài dù hěn rèn zhēn , dàn shuō huà bù zhòng .
lines.en: She takes it seriously without speaking harshly.

lines.zh: 你刚才的态度让我以为你生气了。
lines.py: nǐ gāng cái de tài dù ràng wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ shēng qì le .
lines.en: Your manner just now made me think you were angry.

lines.zh: 我答应周二陪你吃饭。
lines.py: wǒ dā yìng zhōu èr péi nǐ chī fàn .
lines.en: I agreed to have dinner with you on Tuesday.

lines.zh: 他答应的事都会记下来。
lines.py: tā dā yìng de shì dū huì jì xià lái .
lines.en: He writes down the things he promises to do.

lines.zh: 我想解释一下为什么没去。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng jiě shì yī xià wèi shén me méi qù .
lines.en: I’d like to explain why I didn’t go.

lines.zh: 这段介绍解释了活动怎么报名。
lines.py: zhè duàn jiè shào jiě shì le huó dòng zěn me bào míng .
lines.en: This introduction explains how to sign up for the event.

lines.zh: 她坚持每周给家里打电话。
lines.py: tā jiān chí měi zhōu gěi jiā lǐ dǎ diàn huà .
lines.en: She keeps calling home every week.

lines.zh: 他坚持自己去，不想让我陪。
lines.py: tā jiān chí zì jǐ qù , bù xiǎng ràng wǒ péi .
lines.en: He insists on going himself and doesn’t want me to accompany him.

turns.pinyin: nǐ zěn me jīn tiān cái shuō ?

pragmatics.situation: Give the answer before a vague future promise

natural.zh: 这次我不去，周二想单独和你吃饭。
natural.py: zhè cì wǒ bù qù , zhōu èr xiǎng dān dú hé nǐ chī fàn .
natural.en: I will skip this one; I would like dinner with you on Tuesday.

pragmatics.note: The event decision is clear and the alternative is specific.

natural.zh: 我回复晚了，让你不好算人数。
natural.py: wǒ huí fù wǎn le , ràng nǐ bù hǎo suàn rén shù .
natural.en: I replied late, which made the headcount difficult.

pragmatics.note: This recognises the effect on planning without inventing the other person’s emotions.

audio.zh: 也不是。最近每天都和人说话，我想在家安静一晚。
audio.py: yě bù shì . zuì jìn měi tiān dōu hé rén shuō huà , wǒ xiǎng zài jiā ān jìng yī wǎn .
audio.en: Not really. I’ve been talking to people every day recently and want a quiet evening at home.

tasks.statement: The speaker already has another event that night.
tasks.why: The speaker says they want a quiet evening, not another event.

audio.zh: 一开始他以为我不想见他，我就把两件事分开解释：我不想参加大聚会，但想和他单独吃饭。我们约了下周二七点，他不用为了我改变周六的活动。
audio.py: yī kāi shǐ tā yǐ wéi wǒ bù xiǎng jiàn tā , wǒ jiù bǎ liǎng jiàn shì fēn kāi jiě shì : wǒ bù xiǎng cān jiā dà jù huì , dàn xiǎng hé tā dān dú chī fàn . wǒ men yuē le xià zhōu èr qī diǎn , tā bù yòng wèi le wǒ gǎi biàn zhōu liù de huó dòng .
audio.en: At first he thought I didn’t want to see him. I explained the two things separately: I didn’t want the big gathering but did want dinner with him. We arranged Tuesday at seven, without changing Saturday’s event for me.

tasks.statement: The Saturday gathering is changed to suit the narrator.
tasks.why: The Tuesday dinner is separate; Saturday does not change.

prompt.py: nǐ bù lái , shì bù xiǎng jiàn wǒ ma ?

choices: 不是，我想周二单独和你吃饭。

对，我不想再有任何见面。
tasks.answer: 不是，我想周二单独和你吃饭。
tasks.why: The reply distinguishes the event from the friendship.

prompt.zh: 这个盒子太大，想把一半留下。怎么才能放进冰箱？
prompt.py: zhè gè hé zi tài dà , xiǎng bǎ yí bàn liú xià . zěn me cái néng fàng jìn bīng xiāng ?
prompt.en: This box is too large, and we want to keep half. How can it fit in the fridge?

choices: 我们先吃一半吧。
把全部吃完，就还剩下一半。
一点不动，就已经只剩一半了。
tasks.why: The reply follows the box-size joke and shared solution.

line.zh: 哪怕只坐十分钟，我【也】想见你一下。

line.en: Even if I can stay only ten minutes, I still want to see you.

notes: 2026-10-07 advanced media/social core. Original AI-assisted draft, checked against the stated inventory and comprehension keys. Native review pending. This is a selected competency route; it does not certify full HSK lexical coverage, exam readiness or learner mastery. Native review: degree of directness between close friends, 才 explaining a delayed reply, and gift/fridge teasing. Timeline checked: Saturday party, birthday phone call, separate Tuesday dinner at seven. 约会 is taught as a date/arranged meeting; this friends’ dinner is not silently labelled romantic.
